name: Scarlet Insignia Ring
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Insignia Rings mark the Scarlet Crusade's members. In Brill, the Forsaken collect them as proof that another zealot has fallen.

sections.title: Tokens of Zealotry
sections.body: Every Scarlet Crusade fighter in Tirisfal Glades wears an insignia ring. Neophytes and zealous friars wear them, as do captains Melrache and Perrine. The Crusade's fiery sigil marks each ring. It identifies members of an order consumed by paranoia. To outsiders, the rings mark Lordaeron's most fanatical human remnant.

sections.title: Bounty of the Dreadlord
sections.body: Deathguard Burgess in Brill collects the rings on Varimathras's orders. He is Lady Sylvanas's dreadlord lieutenant. The Forsaken see the Scarlet Crusade as a pestilence across their newly claimed homeland. Recruits bring rings back to Brill as proof of a Crusader's death and their loyalty to the throne of the Undercity.

faq.answer: Nearly every Scarlet Crusade member stationed in Tirisfal Glades wears an insignia ring. Neophytes, missionaries, zealots and vanguards wear them, along with field officers Captain Perrine, Captain Melrache and Captain Vachon.

faq.q: Why does Deathguard Burgess want Scarlet Insignia Rings?
faq.answer: Deathguard Burgess collects the rings as proof that Scarlet Crusaders are being killed. He follows orders from Varimathras and the Dark Lady. In Brill, the Forsaken garrison uses the rings to judge recruits' loyalty and success in clearing humans from Lordaeron.

faq.q: What does the insignia on the ring represent?
faq.answer: The ring bears the Scarlet Crusade's mark and represents its holy war to eradicate all undeath from Lordaeron. Crusaders wear it with fierce pride as a badge of righteousness. Their obsession drives them to slaughter anyone outside their order.

faq.q: What role does Varimathras have in collecting these rings?
faq.answer: Varimathras is Sylvanas Windrunner's chief lieutenant in the Undercity. He oversees military efforts against hostile living humans in Tirisfal Glades. The Scarlet Crusade is a priority for Forsaken commanders such as Executor Zygand and Deathguard Burgess.

angles.text: As Forsaken, tearing these rings from dead Crusaders declares that Tirisfal belongs to the dead. It also fulfills the orders of the Dark Lady and Varimathras.
As Horde, collecting these rings helps secure a foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms. Each one weakens the fanatical crusaders around the Undercity.
